coaching.headline: We held more Primal Fangtooths than they did, then lost every fight that mattered to Shinbi and The Fey.
coaching.team: We actually controlled the late objective board — we took Fangtooth at 6, 13 and 18 and Primal Fangtooth at 24 and 29 — but it didn't matter because we lost the team fights around them. The decisive one was the 13.6 Fangtooth fight (2-4) that gave Shinbi and The Fey the early lead, and the game ended on a 32.2 fight at their Orb Prime (1-3). In between, a bad trade at their half (22.4, 1-4) and a 24.2 loss on our own Primal Fangtooth (0-2) kept the bleeding going. The Fey (34k magical) was their biggest damage threat and the film flags Boris and Greystone with no magic resist. Towers: 3 to their 9. Taking objectives is good — but the fight has to be won first, and we kept contesting majors without the bodies to hold them.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Losing the 13.6 Fangtooth fight (2-4) early to Shinbi and The Fey, then the 32.2 Orb Prime fight (1-3) — we took the camps but never the fights, with the film flagging no magic resist on Boris and Greystone vs 34k.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Boris was the unfavored jungle (theirs all game vs Shinbi) and 8 deaths showed it. Mr_Meat31 fronts the 13.6 Fangtooth loss that set the tone, and carried no magic resist into a 4-magical comp — that's why Boris melted. The engage has to pick winnable fights; into a fed Shinbi with the wrong build, those weren't.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Iggy & Scorch put up real numbers (23k hero damage, 20k to objectives) but died 6 times. Goldilocks324's zone damage helped take the camps; the issue was the lost fights like 13.6, and at 32.2 the macro shows him pinned while the team fought without him. A setup mid's value is area denial from range, not trading into The Fey in fights the team couldn't win.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zinx was the unfavored support (theirs all game vs Steel) and 6 deaths came from the lost team fights. The Lunaria came at 27, too late to swing the early ones. The support's reads matter most — after the 13.6 and 22.4 losses, the call was to stop contesting majors the team couldn't hold and reset for vision.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Greystone was favored into Akeron but Willy Guggenheim finished 1/6 with no magic resist into a 4-magical comp. The macro flags him alive and ahead at 9.7, 13.6 and 24.2 while those fights were lost, and he fell in the 22.4 bad trade. As the favored frontline, the team needed Greystone alive to peel The Fey; the build hole and the absences cost both.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Drongo was favored but the line went 4/6 with 14617 hero damage. Xeebs was in the 22.4 bad trade (1-4) at their half and the 24.2 loss on our own Primal Fangtooth. The ranged carry's damage has to be online and safe in those objective fights — Drongo was neither, and a favored lane went to waste.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
ourKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
ourKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
enemyKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

fedBy: Nature's Vengeance (passive): Each time The Fey achieves a Takedown she spawns an Untamed Growth from the Enemy Hero's corpse and gains 30% movement speed for 3s.
lines: Fly Trap at rank 3: 95s base, about 80.5s by the end (15% shorter) from 18 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Epoch 8.
21 takedowns (15 kills, 6 assists) fed: Nature's Vengeance (passive).
The Fey dealt 34,140 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +400 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Iggy & Scorch (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 29 after penetration; took 14,678 magical damage from heroes, 78% of all hero damage they took) and Boris (level 15: about 53 magical armor, 33 after penetration; took 23,421 magical damage from heroes, 75% of all hero damage they took) that is about 16% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Toughness: +250 health; took 21,002 damage, mitigated 10,304, died 3 times.

Lesson: The Fey's penetration cut through: Iggy & Scorch took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 49, about 29 after 20 flat penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Megacosm. The Fey has 4 damaging abilities (Untamed Growth, Bramble Patch hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 18 ability haste brought them back 15% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players The Fey killed built magical armor (Zinx). Anti-heal on Greystone. We killed The Fey 3 times.
Copy it? this 3-item core: 69.2% in 133 games, above the 55.8% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.
